architecture.arbiter: round robin DMA versus compute; priority changes on every successful grant; pause gates only new grants
architecture.invalid_physical_word: full 64-bit address checked before narrowing; error response at next edge, no RAM request/alias
architecture.RAM_init: tc_sram SimInit=zeros at reset; premeasurement initialization, no free post-t0 C++ writes
architecture.ordinary_memory_scope: frozen source DMA uses aligned ordinary 64-bit transfers; compute uses aligned 64-bit reads and byte-strobed 32-bit stores. ATOP/lock memory requests are error responses, not implemented atomics.

compute.command: ready/valid once in Idle; latch slots, s/t and all generation inputs
compute.indices: source i=0..15, j=0..15, k=0..255; s/t must be below16
compute.A_address: base + aslot*16384 + (i*256+k)*4, aligned down8, extract half from k&1
compute.B_address: base + 32768 + bslot*16384 + (j*256+k)*4, aligned down8, extract half from k&1
compute.C_address: base + 65536 + cslot*16384 + (i*256+t*16+j)*4, aligned down8, strb0x0F or0xF0
compute.arithmetic: unchanged production multiplier MUL, zeroextended32-bit operands; resultlow32 plus accumulator32 modulo2^32
compute.memory_cost: each MAC performs separate actual A and B reads, then actual multiplier issue/consume; each output performs actual byte-strobed C grant and next-edge write acknowledgment
compute.done: DonePending follows successful final C write acknowledgment; require only compute-owned memory token and multiplier empty. Does not wait for unrelated DMA token/queue; done s/t retained from accepted command. comp_busy stays asserted through done edge.
compute.generation_scope: all generation tags latched; software controller/root validator owns dependency/generation legality, not inferred by RAM hardware

observation.sampling: pre-positive-edge signals describe the event consumed at that upcoming edge
observation.response: exact prior-edge grant owner/address/kind/error; write and error rdata canonicalzero, successful read SRAM latency1 data
observation.MAC: valid on product consumption in MulWait; a/b/i/j/k/s/t remain associated with that product; mac_acc includes current product
observation.AXI: all contract AW/AR/W/R/B taps are direct endpoint interface observations; no altered handshake

busy_and_fault.spm_busy: bridge busy OR DMA memoryrequest OR compute memoryrequest OR memory response token OR multiplier valid OR AXI transaction counters; counters retire only B or RLAST handshakes (include error ATOP read obligation)

fault_sticky_until_reset.bit1: compute response error or read/write kind mismatch

busy_and_fault.fault_response: no success done; commandready blocked while sticky fault set; AXI memory range errors returned through AXI and do not directly poison compute fault
